question: Would shortening the gateway cache solve draining, and which disconnected requests can be retried safely under the supplied contract?

criteria.instruction: A shorter cache only reduces stale arrivals; local admission fencing and active-stream management remain necessary. An explicitly not-admitted s3 can be retried. Original accepted s1/s2 lack terminal receipts and need their request identity/idempotency and reconciliation rules; do not automatically start new-ID executions. Their provider/billing outcome remains uncertain.
Connect supervisor proposals, D12 retry distinction, original missing receipts and repair/limits documents.
Do not promise exactly-once provider execution, no repeat billing or safe new-ID retries from connection closure. Do not claim d18 deployed.
